summary.text: Robert People is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 15th Congressional District. A retired U.S. Army veteran who served from 1997 to 2018, he describes himself as running to continue public service. He says he is running on protecting Social Security, women's reproductive and health rights, and raising teacher pay.

paragraphs.text: People was born in Baltimore, Maryland, graduated from Parkville High School, and attended the University of Maryland Global Campus.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1997 to 2018, which he describes as 21 years of service, and lists his career experience as a writer.
He says he is 46 years old and is running because he wants to continue public service rather than remain on the sidelines.
